He wears a black cap and white socks. In the foreground, several large stability balls in blue and grey sit on the floor. The background includes various gym equipment, red benches, and yellow rule signs on the wall. (2) The man moves closer to the mirror, flexing his arms and chest to display significant muscle definition. His skin shows tattoos on both his upper arms. He holds the smartphone in his right hand. The bright indoor lighting creates strong shadows that emphasize his muscle separation. He maintains a focused facial expression while observing his reflection. (3) The creator lifts his black tank top with his left hand, revealing a lean torso with highly defined abdominal muscles. He continues to record the details of his midsection with the phone held steady. The background gym environment remains visible, showing other gym-goers walking in the distance. (4) Lowering his shirt, the man strikes a final side-posing stance, highlighting his shoulder and arm muscles. He places his left hand on his hip while looking at the phone screen. The video maintains a high-quality, clear visual style typical of social media fitness content as he completes his physique check.
